name: Improved Arrow of Death
body:
You are feared by even the most powerful creatures, for one sting from your arrows can leave any being lifeless at your feet. Before facing you, many of your opponents utter a prayer to their God, knowing that they will probably be with them soon.

Prerequisite(s): 10th-level Arcane Archer

Benefit: This feat allows you to use your arrow of death once more per day.
